budget.metric: relative error of the simulated surface error of a milled wall (deflection imprinted on the surface, Budak) or of the surface location error (Insperger), at the measured axial position or spindle speed; and of the maximum normal force where the case gives it
budget.note: The wall error is the cutting force times the tool compliance: with the force inside its budget (15-20 %) and an end-mill compliance from a model known to about 15 % when the chuck stiffness is measured, the root sum is about 20-25 %. Budak's own model with identified coefficients and measured stiffness differs from his measurements by up to about 15 %, his static stiffness predictions by 0.7-2.7 %, but the equivalent flute diameter he needs differs between tools (0.85 d and about 0.74 d), which alone changes the bending stiffness by a factor 1.7 (computed here, (0.85/0.74)^4). The measured profiles carry 2-4 um of digitisation and dial-gauge reading; Insperger's SLE is estimated from tool deflection measured 65 mm above the tip (stated uncertainty 6 %).
